answer: Just as a zephyr-driven dune shifts grain by grain, an agent economy can bind each identity to a bonded stake whose history is hashed into a shared append-only ledger, making pseudonym creation costly. Layered verification, like shale strata compacting under pressure, requires new agents to accumulate attestations from distinct stake-weighted peers before transacting. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
